{{Quote|Tell the infidel that I have a much more important duty for him to perform. Tell him that I have just appointed him President of Ylesia and Commander in Chief of the Peace Brigade.|Shimrra Jamaane to Nom Anor|<ref name="Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>}}
The '''President of Ylesia''' was a title given to the the leader of both the [[Ylesian Republic]] and [[Peace Brigade]]. The position was created by [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane|Shimrra]] and given to [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]].<ref name="Ylesia" />
